name: Mangarr
description: Monitor manga series, download missing chapters, and organize CBZ files for Komga or Kavita.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent database, API key, and settings.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Shared media folder. Use /media/manga as a root folder and /media/torrents as the downloads folder.

paths.name: Manga Library
paths.description: Bind the image-declared /manga volume to the same manga library folder.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Optional. User id to run as, e.g. 99 (nobody). Leave empty to run as root. Set together with PGID.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Optional. Group id to run as, e.g. 100 (users). Leave empty to run as root. Set together with PUID.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Optional. umask for new files and folders, e.g. 002 for 664/775.
